title: AI配置不足1万亿：增速20%到30%，六网建设能否撑起跨越式增长？
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: How do you see AI filtering? I mean, how does it all, I guess, in some ways, reshape that investment mix right now within these six newcomers?
segments.zh: 你怎么看AI的渗透？它是否正在重塑六网建设中的配置结构？

segments.en: That's right. The AI investment at the moment is still in baby form. From all we can put together and add it, it's not yet one trillion RMB as of 2026.
segments.zh: 没错，目前AI相关配置仍处于起步阶段，综合测算到2026年还不到1万亿元。

segments.en: So it's still relatively small, but we think that it is growing at a very fast pace. We think it can grow as something like around 20 to 30 percent per year.
segments.zh: 规模仍然较小，但我们认为增速非常快，每年可能达到20%到30%左右。

segments.en: So by 2028, 2029, this is going to grow to a much bigger part compared to the drag that we see still from the property sector.
segments.zh: 到2028、2029年，它将成长为更大的部分，与地产领域仍存在的拖累形成对比。

segments.en: Because probably sector drag is becoming smaller and smaller, and AI becoming bigger and bigger, so that in a way, we think that in the next one to two years, we probably will see a full offset coming from the AI sector
segments.zh: 因为地产拖累可能越来越小，AI越来越大，未来一到两年，AI领域可能形成完全对冲。

segments.en: to help at a time that property sector is still on the man. But that said, the six networks is the kind of pre-condition for AI sector to continue to grow by leaps and bounds going forward.
segments.zh: 在地产仍处于调整之时提供支撑。但话说回来，六网建设是AI领域继续跨越式增长的前提条件。

segments.en: Because you need the power, you need the water, you need the compute power and communication networks to work together. So we think that this is therefore a very important area where there could be more investment now,
segments.zh: 因为需要电力、水资源、算力和通信网络协同运作，因此这是一个非常重要的领域，现在可能有更多配置。

segments.en: and we don't have to worry about the overcapacity in the near future. So that is key for AI development and key for Chinese current counter-cyclical policy adjustment as well.
segments.zh: 短期内不必担心产能过剩，这对AI发展至关重要，对中国当前逆周期政策调整同样关键。
